def test_stock_semantic_ranking_adversarial_pairs():
    """Adversarial pairs testing layered semantic evaluation."""
    retriever = StoryStockRetriever()

    # Pair 1: Night city vs sunny beach
    pair_1 = [
        {"id": "sunny", "title": "sunny tropical beach with palm trees", "duration": 10.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"},
        {"id": "night_city", "title": "dramatic night city skyline with skyscrapers and neon lights", "duration": 25.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"}
    ]
    ranked_1 = retriever.rank_candidates(pair_1, target_intent="night city skyline", target_duration=10.0)
    assert ranked_1[0]["id"] == "night_city"

    # Pair 2: Isolated sad woman vs crowd celebration
    pair_2 = [
        {"id": "crowd", "title": "huge crowd celebration festival concert cheering", "duration": 10.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"},
        {"id": "sad_woman", "title": "sad woman sitting alone in dimly lit empty apartment", "duration": 20.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"}
    ]
    ranked_2 = retriever.rank_candidates(pair_2, target_intent="sad woman sitting alone", target_duration=10.0)
    assert ranked_2[0]["id"] == "sad_woman"

    # Pair 3: Phone on table vs person holding basketball
    pair_3 = [
        {"id": "basketball", "title": "young person holding basketball outdoors on court", "duration": 10.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"},
        {"id": "phone", "title": "smartphone vibrating on dark wooden desk table close up", "duration": 20.0, "rights_status": "ELIGIBLE"}
    ]
    ranked_3 = retriever.rank_candidates(pair_3, target_intent="smartphone vibrating on wooden desk", target_duration=10.0)
    assert ranked_3[0]["id"] == "phone"

def test_visual_requirement_query_compilation():
    """Query compilation must prioritize visualizable concepts over raw narration."""
    v_req = VisualRequirement(
        required_visuals=["smartphone", "wooden desk", "dim lighting"],
        forbidden_visuals=["outdoor", "crowd"],
        preferred_source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE,
        stock_search_intent="smartphone on desk vibrating incoming call dread"
    )
    raw_narration = "Everything she believed about her husband was about to collapse into nothingness."

    retriever = StoryStockRetriever()
    query = retriever.compile_search_query(v_req, narration=raw_narration)

    # Must contain visualizable elements
    assert any(term in query.lower() for term in ("smartphone", "phone", "desk", "table", "call"))
    # Must NOT merely dump abstract narration keywords
    assert "collapse" not in query.lower()
    assert "believed" not in query.lower()
